description: Turn a product page URL from a supported shop into structured product data — EAN barcode, price, stock status, and a purchase link — so the EAN can then be used with get_best_price or optimize_cart. Multi-variant product families return a labeled candidate list (size/colour, price, EAN per variant): ask the user to pick a variant, then use that exact variant's EAN with the other tools.

country.description: Country for pricing (DE or AT, default DE)

url.description: Product page URL from a supported shop (e.g. 'https://www.rosebikes.de/p/<product-name>-<id>')

name: resolve_product

axis.description: Variant axis of the options: 'size', 'colour', 'mixed', 'size_name' or 'name'.

family_url.description: Branded /go/ link to the product family page so the user can pick the variant.

options.description: Variants of ONE product. Ask the user to pick one, then use that variant's EAN.

donor_label.description: Verbatim variant/product name; use as the choice label when present.

ean.description: EAN of this exact variant; null when the shop has no barcode for this size — then there is no price comparison, use product_url.

in_stock.description: Stock at the input shop; null when unknown per variant.

price.description: Price at the input shop; null when only a family-level page price exists.

product_name.description: Verbatim product name for a flat name-axis option; use as the choice label when present.

product_url.description: Direct /go/ link to this exact size at the input shop.

status.description: 'not_resolved' when the exact variant could not be determined; 'pick_variant' when labeled variant options are returned to choose from.

title: Resolve Product URL
